q.t: How many sides does a triangle have?
q.e: ‘Tri’ means three.

q.t: How many sides does a quadrilateral have?
q.e: ‘Quad’ means four.

q.t: How many sides does a pentagon have?
q.e: ‘Penta’ means five.

q.t: How many sides does a hexagon have?
q.e: ‘Hexa’ means six.

q.t: A closed figure made only of line segments is called a:
q.e: ‘Poly’ means many and ‘gon’ means angle — many angles, so many straight sides.

q.t: Is a circle a polygon?
o: No — it has no straight sides
q.e: A polygon’s boundary is made of line segments; a circle is curved.

q.t: How many sides does an octagon have?
q.e: ‘Octa’ means eight.

q.t: A polygon with all sides equal and all angles equal is called:
q.e: Regular means the same all the way round.

q.t: How many vertices does a hexagon have?
q.e: A polygon has as many corners as it has sides.

q.t: What is the smallest number of sides a polygon can have?
q.e: Two segments cannot close up a space; three can.

q.t: How many diagonals does a quadrilateral have?
q.e: A diagonal joins two corners that are not next to each other. There are two such pairs.

q.t: How many diagonals does a triangle have?
q.e: Every pair of corners is already joined by a side.

q.t: How many diagonals does a pentagon have?
q.e: Each corner joins to 2 non-neighbours. 5 × 2 counts each diagonal twice: 5.

q.t: How many sides does a heptagon have?
q.e: ‘Hepta’ means seven.

q.t: How many sides does a nonagon have?
q.e: ‘Nona’ means nine.

q.t: How many sides does a decagon have?
q.e: ‘Deca’ means ten, as in decade.

q.t: A regular triangle is also called:
q.e: Regular means all sides and angles equal.

q.t: A regular quadrilateral is a:
q.e: Only a square has both equal sides and equal angles.

q.t: Two sides of a polygon that share a vertex are called:
q.e: Adjacent means next to each other.

q.t: A polygon with at least one angle greater than 180° is called:
q.e: It ‘caves in’ at that corner.

q.t: How many diagonals does a hexagon have?
q.e: Each of the 6 corners joins to 3 non-neighbours: 6 × 3 ÷ 2 = 9.

q.t: How many diagonals can be drawn from ONE vertex of a hexagon?
q.e: From any corner you cannot join to itself or its two neighbours: 6 − 3 = 3.

q.t: How many diagonals does an octagon have?
A polygon has 5 diagonals. How many sides does it have?
q.e: The pentagon is the one polygon with 5 diagonals (5 × 2 ÷ 2).

q.t: Find the perimeter of a regular hexagon of side 4.5 cm (in cm).
q.e: Six equal sides: 6 × 4.5.

q.t: A regular pentagon has perimeter 35 cm. Find its side (in cm).
q.e: Five equal sides share 35 cm.

q.t: All the diagonals from one vertex of a pentagon are drawn. How many triangles are formed?
q.e: Diagonals from one corner always make (sides − 2) triangles.

q.t: A polygon has 12 vertices. How many sides does it have?
q.e: Sides and vertices are always equal in number.

q.t: How many diagonals can be drawn from one vertex of a decagon?
Which of these is NOT a polygon?
o: An open shape made of 4 segments
q.e: A polygon must be closed, with the last side joining back to the first.

q.t: How many diagonals does a decagon have?
A polygon has 9 diagonals. How many sides does it have?
q.k: [n for n in range(3,30) if n*(n-3)==18][0]
q.e: A hexagon: 6 × 3 ÷ 2 = 9.

q.t: A polygon has 14 diagonals. How many sides does it have?
q.k: [n for n in range(3,30) if n*(n-3)==28][0]
q.e: A heptagon: 7 × 4 ÷ 2 = 14.

q.t: A regular octagon has perimeter 62.4 cm. Find its side (in cm).
All the diagonals from one vertex of a 12-sided polygon are drawn. How many triangles are formed?
q.e: sides − 2 = 10.

q.t: Which polygon has the same number of diagonals as sides?
q.e: A pentagon has 5 sides and 5 diagonals.

q.t: How many diagonals does a heptagon have?
Six points are marked so that no three are on a line. How many segments join them in pairs?
q.e: 6 × 5 ÷ 2 = 15 — the 6 sides of the hexagon plus its 9 diagonals.

q.t: From one vertex of a polygon, 9 diagonals can be drawn. How many sides does it have?
q.e: Diagonals from one vertex = sides − 3, so sides = 12.
